seoTitle: Vesting Schedule Calculator With Cliff and Monthly Vesting
metaDescription: Show vested shares at each month for a cliff plus monthly schedule and the vested amount on a chosen date. Free, private.
intro: Calculates vested shares over time for a schedule with a cliff and monthly vesting.
why:
A typical grant vests over four years with a one-year cliff: nothing vests until the cliff date, then a share for each month vests. The calculator shows the amount at the cliff and later months, rounding down to whole shares.

Give start date, length, cliff and a check date. Plans differ on rounding, step size and acceleration, so follow your grant document for the final figure.
howTo: Enter shares, start date, length and cliff.
Read the vested amount and the schedule.

faq.a: The shares for the cliff period vest at once.
Rounded down; the last month vests the rest.
